items.summaryZh: 因开发者个人事务，项目暂停更新1周。期间将暂停代码推送、Issue 与 PR 处理，现有功能不受影响。预计1周内恢复开发，感谢理解。
items.bodyZh:
尊敬的社区成员与用户：

感谢您一直以来对本项目的关注与支持。由于开发者个人事务安排，本项目将进入为期 **1周** 左右的维护暂停期。

**暂停期间安排如下：**
- 代码仓库将不再接收新的 Commit 推送。
- 暂不审核与处理新提交的 Issue 与 Pull Request。
- 现有版本功能、文档及已合并代码不受影响。

预计开发工作将于 **一周后** 逐步恢复。届时我们将优先处理期间积累的反馈与合并请求。由此带来的不便，敬请谅解。

感谢您的理解与耐心等待。

2026年4月19日
items.summaryEn: Due to personal commitments, project updates will be paused for 1 week. No new commits, issue reviews, or PR merges will occur during this period; existing functionality remains unaffected. Development is expected to resume within 1 week. Thank you for your understanding.
items.bodyEn:
Dear community members and users,

Thank you for your continued support and interest in this project. Due to personal commitments, development will be temporarily paused for **1 week**.

**During this suspension period:**
- No new commits will be pushed to the repository.
- New issues and pull requests will not be reviewed or processed.
- Existing versions, documentation, and previously merged code remain fully accessible and unaffected.

Development is expected to resume within **1 week**. Upon returning, we will prioritize addressing pending feedback and merge requests. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding and patience.

Project Maintainer  
April 19, 2026

items.titleZh: 关于合并更新通道的说明
items.bodyZh:
在「Citlali」开发周期中，我们将对更新通道进行整合优化：

- **预览通道合并**：原 Alpha / Beta / Pre 三个预览版本通道将统一合并为 **Preview** 通道
- **Canary 通道调整**：予以保留，但作为实验性通道（Experiment）默认隐藏，需通过「实验室」功能手动开启
- **用户无感迁移**：原设置为「不接收预览版本更新」的用户将自动归入 **Stable** 通道，使用体验与此前完全一致

本次调整旨在简化版本发布流程，降低用户对更新机制的理解成本，同时为后续迭代提供更清晰的测试分级。
items.bodyEn:
During the "Citlali" development cycle, we will streamline the update channel structure:

- **Preview Channel Consolidation**: The Alpha, Beta, and Pre preview channels will be merged into a single **Preview** channel
- **Canary Channel Adjustment**: Retained but reclassified as an experimental channel (Experiment); hidden by default and accessible only via the "Labs" settings
- **Seamless User Migration**: Users previously opted out of preview updates will be automatically assigned to the **Stable** channel, with no change to their update experience

This consolidation simplifies our release workflow, reduces complexity for end users, and establishes a clearer testing hierarchy for future development iterations.
